scientific_target: candidate families with the same recorded chemical representation while topology and measured geometry remain free to vary

composition_normalization.scope: all elements in the parsed CIF structure

required_evidence: successful raw-CIF audit and raw/parsed element-set agreement
valid nonnegative metal, linker, and functional cluster labels
negative_cluster_policy: ARC-MOF negative cluster labels mean unclustered/assumed unique; they never place two frameworks in one chemistry family
mixed_metal_policy: mixed-metal frameworks are not automatically excluded; they require the same normalized whole-CIF and metal-element compositions
oxidation_state_policy: oxidation state is unavailable in Stage 1.2 and is not inferred
pair_policy: family membership is not pair acceptance; connectivity and linker/node identity must be checked later for proposed comparisons
known_limitations: whole-CIF composition is not a framework-only composition
RAC/DBSCAN cluster agreement is similarity evidence, not identity proof
bond connectivity and framework membership are not inferred here
no geometry contrast or adsorption effect is accepted at this stage
